market.question: Will Bitcoin dip to $45,000 by December 31, 2026?

assessment.reasoning: BTC at ~$76,300; needs to dip to $45k = -41% by Dec 31, 2026. YTD low so far is ~$60k (Feb 2026). A drop to $45k would require a major capitulation - historically BTC has -50% drawdowns from peaks but going from current consolidation to $45k requires further breakdown. With ~8 months remaining, moderate but lower-probability tail event.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Whether a recession or systemic shock triggers a major risk-off cascade in 2H 2026.
